name: com.warnpoint/warnpoint
title: WARNPOINT
description: Live conflict data, satellite before/after images and heat detected from space. No API key.

tools.name: get_threat_index
tools.description: The WARNPOINT Global Threat Index (WPI, 0–100, five tiers GUARDED…CRITICAL) right now, with what drives it: major conflicts, escalating countries and active warnings.

tools.name: list_country_risk
tools.description: Countries ranked by WARNPOINT instability score (0–100) from the last 24h of reporting, with tier and report counts.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: One country: instability score and tier, latest headline, its incidents in the last 24h and any internet outage. Accepts a name ("Sudan") or ISO code ("SD").

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166 alpha-2 code

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: Located incidents (strikes, missile and drone attacks, airstrikes, explosions, military movement) reported in the last 24h, newest first, each with its outlets.

country.description: Optional country name or ISO code

tools.name: top_news
tools.description: The top world-news stories right now, clustered across outlets and ranked by breadth, recency and severity.

tools.name: conflict_warnings
tools.description: WARNPOINT escalation scenarios (e.g. Russia–NATO, Iran–Israel, Gulf, Taiwan Strait): level, tripwires tripped and the assessment.

tools.name: internet_outages
tools.description: Ongoing national internet outages measured by IODA (Georgia Tech), plus disruptions confirmed by Cloudflare Radar with their cause when available.

tools.name: space_weather
tools.description: Current NOAA space-weather scales (geomagnetic storms G, radio blackouts R, radiation storms S), Kp index, the 3-day forecast and what it means for GPS, radio and polar flights.

tools.name: satellite_watch
tools.description: Reported strike sites WARNPOINT watches from space: Sentinel-2 / Sentinel-1 before/after image pairs (true colour, fire and infrared views) and NASA FIRMS heat detections near each site, with pass times and how long after the first report each was taken. Not live imagery.

show.description: images = before/after ready, heat = heat detected near the site, waiting = waiting for a clear pass (default all)
